facts.statement: The holotype of Colymbosaurus is a humerus found in the Kimmeridge Clay Formation of Oxfordshire, England.
facts.quote: The holotype of the species, NHMUK PV OR 31787, a humerus (upper arm bone), comes from the Kimmeridgian Kimmeridge Clay Formation of Shotover, Oxfordshire, England.

facts.statement: The species C. svalbardensis was described from fossils discovered in the Agardhfjellet Formation of Svalbard, Norway, in the winter of 1930-31.
facts.quote: The distribution of Colymbosaurus was extended beyond the UK when the Norwegian "Tricleidus" svalbardensis was recognized as a valid species of Colymbosaurus, C. svalbardensis, based on the holotype, discovered in the winter of 1930-31 in the Agardhfjellet Formation

facts.statement: Colymbosaurus is an extinct genus of plesiosaur described by Harry Seeley in 1874 from fossils found in England.
facts.quote: Colymbosaurus es un género extinto del orden Plesiosauria descrito en 1874 por Harry Seeley a partir de fósiles hallados en Inglaterra.

facts.statement: The known fossil remains include 74 vertebrae, ribs, a scapula, and the front and rear flippers.
facts.quote: Los huesos encontrados incluyen 74 vértebras, costillas, una escápula y las aletas delanteras y posteriores.

facts.statement: Some scientists debate whether Colymbosaurus is actually part of Kimmerosaurus, a genus known only from skull and cervical vertebrae elements.
facts.quote: Hay científicos que piensan que Colymbosaurus en realidad es una parte de Kimmerosaurus, del cual solo se conocen elementos del cráneo y vértebras cervicales.

facts.statement: A taxonomic revision led to the resurrection of C. megadeirus as the type species of Colymbosaurus after it was previously synonymized with C. trochantericus.
facts.quote: Because of this revision, megadeirus was resurrected as the epithet of the type species of Colymbosaurus.

facts.statement: Colymbosaurus is classified within the family Cryptoclididae.
Colymbosaurus lived during the Middle to Late Jurassic (Callovian to Tithonian stages) in the UK and Svalbard, Norway.
facts.quote: Colymbosaurus is a genus of cryptoclidid plesiosaur from the Middle-Late Jurassic (Callovian-Tithonian) of the UK and Svalbard, Norway.

facts.statement: The time range for Colymbosaurus is estimated from 168.2 to 113.2 million years ago, spanning the Bathonian to Aptian stages.
facts.quote: Time range: Bathonian to Aptian (168.2 to 113.2 million years ago)

rejected.statement: Harry Govier Seeley established the genus Colymbosaurus in 1874 by recognizing Plesiosaurus megadeirus as a distinct genus.
rejected.quote: Harry Govier Seeley came to recognize Plesiosaurus megadeirus as generically distinct, and coined the name Colymbosaurus for the species.
